profile.headline: Software Engineer 💻 | Full-Stack .NET Developer | C#, WPF, WinForms, SQL | Building High-Performance Systems |
profile.summary:
I’m a Full-Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building high-performance .NET, SQL and windows-based applications across automotive, healthcare, and enterprise domains.

Tech Stack: C#, .NET, WinForms, WPF, SQL, JavaScript, React, Node.js, AWS, Git

I’m actively exploring opportunities where I can contribute to impactful products, grow with collaborative teams, and work in a healthy, inclusive culture.

positions.description:

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Maintained the Engaged Learning to Promote STEM Graduation (ELPSG) website, a project funded by the National Science Foundation (NSF).
• Utilized HTML, JavaScript, and CSS to ensure the smooth functioning and visual appeal of the website.
• Took responsibility for managing the project's social media accounts on Instagram, effectively promoting the initiative and engaging with the target audience.
• Ensured regular updates and content management on the website to provide valuable information and resources to STEM students.
• Collaborated with the project team to implement interactive features and user-friendly interfaces, enhancing the overall user experience.
• Demonstrated strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills while troubleshooting any technical issues or website maintenance requirements.
• Actively participated in team meetings and discussions to brainstorm ideas and strategies for improving the website's functionality and user engagement.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•Served as a Teaching Assistant for multiple courses, including Network Forensics, Computational Bioinformatics, and Network Protocols.
•Assisted students in understanding and completing course work, providing guidance and support to enhance their learning experience.
•Collaborated with the course instructors to design lab manuals, ensuring the effective delivery of practical sessions and reinforcing theoretical concepts.
•Conducted regular office hours and provided one-on-one assistance to address students' questions, concerns, and difficulties related to the course material.

projects.title: Federated Sentiment Analysis on Amazon Review Data
projects.description:
• Conducted research on sentiment analysis, focusing on the challenges of training accurate models with limited labeled datasets and the limitations of centralized models.
• Proposed and implemented a federated learning approach for sentiment analysis, leveraging decentralized machine learning techniques.
• Collaborated with a server and multiple clients to train reliable and accurate sentiment analysis models without transferring data to a central server.
• Developed a prototype implementation using Amazon review datasets to evaluate the performance of the federated learning approach.
• Utilized the FedAvg algorithm to aggregate parameters from trained client models and build a global model for sentiment analysis of new categories with no available labeled datasets.
• Achieved a 10% improvement in sentiment analysis performance compared to traditional centralized models.
• Demonstrated the potential of federated learning in training better data analytical models for categories with limited large-scale labeled datasets.
• Published research findings in UHCL thesis dissertations.
• Contributed to the advancement of the field of sentiment analysis and decentralized machine learning

projects.title: LivBand
projects.description:
• Built a Healthcare Band to monitor patient’s data.
• Generated the basic flow of the band by including various sensors.
• Created multiple tables to store all appropriate data and used SQL queries to retrieve data.
• Produced a web interface to enter and view patient data and Validated data and tested the user view.
